counterparty: resting liquidity providers on the thin side of the book

economic_mechanism: Counterparty: the resting orders and slower participants on the thin side who get run over. Persists only inside the latency window of the fastest participants; disappears once the signal is tradeable at our latency (the move happens before our order arrives). Known to be real but captured by faster players; a slow participant pays the spread to chase it.
